model_output_policy.observation_boundary: completed native tool calls and typed native events

provider_wait_policy.action: wait for native completion/error or authorized cancellation

role_session.disclosure: Distinct author/reviewer roles; this role retains its own prior conversation and findings.

submission_completion.scope: Accepted stage artifact only; later mathematical gates remain required.

transport_health.scope: Native Codex error and stdio-reader events; HTTP transport and actual service tier are not intercepted.

usage.definition: Cumulative native thread counters minus the saved role baseline. Duplicate snapshots are not summed. Per-provider-response coverage and actual tier are not exposed; cached/reasoning are subsets.

exposure.scope: Hash-bound native configuration, supplied role instructions and stdio tool/work requests. Native built-in instructions and context management are retained. Provider HTTP payloads and actual tier are not intercepted or certified.

T010 : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : V n × ℝ → W m) (q : W m),
  ((∀ (t0 : ℝ),
        0 < t0 →
          ∃ C R,
            IsCompact C ∧
              0 < R ∧
                C ⊆ innerBox n R ∧
                  C ⊆ interior (box n R) ∧
                    IsCompact (box n R) ∧
                      MeasurableSet (box n R) ∧
                        volume (box n R) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ n) ∧
                          volume (box n R) < ⊤ ∧
                            (∀ x ∉ C, ∀ r ∈ Icc (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2), u (x, r) = q) ∧
                              (∀ (k : ℕ),
                                  0 < k → ∀ x ∉ C, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2), iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u (x, r) = 0) ∧
                                ∀ f ∈ fields u,
                                  ∀ r ∈ Ioo (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2),
                                    (Continuous fun x => f (x, r)) ∧
                                      (∀ x ∉ C, f (x, r) = 0) ∧
                                        (HasCompactSupport fun x => f (x, r)) ∧
                                          Integrable (fun x => f (x, r)) volume ∧
                                            (∃ K,
                                                0 ≤ K ∧
                                                  (∀ x ∈ box n R, |f (x, r)| ≤ K) ∧
                                                    ∫ (x : V n), |f (x, r)| ≤ K * (volume (box n R)).toReal) ∧
                                              ∃ U, IsOpen U ∧ frontier (box n R) ⊆ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, f (x, r) = 0) ∧
      ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → Integrable (fun x => e u x r) volume) →
    (∀ (t0 : ℝ),
          0 < t0 → HasDerivAt (energy u) (∫ (x : V n), et u x t0) t0 ∧ deriv (energy u) t0 = ∫ (x : V n), et u x t0) ∧
        DifferentiableOn ℝ (energy u) (Ioi 0) →
      (∀ (t0 : ℝ),
          0 < t0 →
            deriv (energy u) t0 = (2 * ∫ (x : V n), A u x t0) + 2 * ∑ j, ∫ (x : V n), B u j x t0 ∧
              deriv (energy u) t0 = (2 * ∫ (x : V n), A u x t0) - 2 * ∑ j, ∫ (x : V n), T u j x t0 ∧
                deriv (energy u) t0 = 2 * ∫ (x : V n), inner ℝ (ut u x t0) (utt u x t0 - lap u x t0) ∧
                  HasDerivAt (energy u) 0 t0) →
        (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → Integrable (fun x => e u x r) volume) ∧
          DifferentiableOn ℝ (energy u) (Ioi 0) ∧
            (∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → deriv (energy u) r = 0) ∧ ∀ (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < t → energy u s = energy u t
